extracted text: The study examines Al-Zn-Mg-Cu alloys with additions of Yb, Cr, and Zr. The alloys were solution treated with a stepped approach: held at 450°C and 470°C separately for 1h, then kept at 480°C for 2h, followed by quenching in ambient temperature water. The plates were then artificially aged at 130°C for 24h to achieve T6 temper. The complex additions of Yb, Cr and Zr formed 20-50nm dispersoids identified as Zn, Mg, Cu, Zr-containing YbCr2Al20 with cubic CeCr2Al20 crystal structure. These dispersoids remarkably inhibited recrystallization and enhanced corrosion resistance.
